name: tag_walls
description: Tag every wall visible in the active view with a horizontal tag at the wall midpoint. Skips walls already tagged in the view. Uses the first wall tag type in the project (falls back to a multi-category tag) unless tag_type_id names one. Returns created tag ids, wall ids/names, and tag locations in mm. Ported from mcp-servers-for-revit tag_all_walls.

params.name: use_leader
params.description: Show a leader line on each created tag.

params.name: tag_type_id
params.description: ElementId of a specific wall tag (or multi-category tag) type to use. Omit (or 0) to use the first one found.
